small_pair_correction: OLS slope on the full fixed symmetric 9-point grid; linear and quadratic slopes coincide; report both and the signed corrected +/-0.002 difference, not an independently estimated sigma
null_policy: No interpolation/imputation/dropping of missing metric samples; report unavailable for that metric
failure_policy: Any baseline mismatch, missing required record or bad numerical setting blocks readiness; no additional simulations authorized
